Main Description: Alien X wields reality-altering power on a cosmic scale, making him one of Ben's most overwhelming transformations.
ABILITY \u2014 Effect: Once per battle, negate one enemy effect and restore 3 damage to your side.
SPECIAL MOVE \u2014 Effect: Reset the battle: remove all active effects and deal 8 damage to every opposing alien.
ULTIMATE \u2014 Effect: Restore all allied durability to full and remove all enemy buffs.

Main Description: Clockwork manipulates temporal energy, allowing him to accelerate, reverse and weaponize time.
ABILITY \u2014 Effect: Once per round, reduce an opponent's next damage by 2 or increase your next damage by 2.
SPECIAL MOVE \u2014 Effect: Send one opposing alien back in time: remove its buffs and it cannot use its Special Move next turn.
ULTIMATE \u2014 Effect: Deal 7 damage and rewind the target's last action, removing the effect it just created.

Main Description: An evolved To'kustar built for colossal combat, combining immense size, strength and cosmic energy projection.
Flavor Quote: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.
ABILITY \u2014 Effect: Cannot be stunned by effects that target a single alien.
SPECIAL MOVE \u2014 Effect: Deal 7 damage to one opponent; if it survives, push it to 1 durability.
ULTIMATE \u2014 Effect: Deal 8 damage to all enemies and ignore all armor.
